svg.title: Morning in the commons
svg.desc: A sunlit solarpunk city in a futurist northern Vietnamese style: towers of stacked curved terracotta roofs with upswept corners, round sun windows and solar glass, a brick tiered tower, a Khuê Văn Các-style gate, photovoltaic roof tiles, rooftop turbines, misty limestone karst peaks, rice terraces, bamboo, a lotus basin, an airship with a junk-style solar sail, Hội An lanterns, wind turbines, a vine-covered light-rail viaduct, kites and a small airship. On a rooftop garden, SOL-9, a small mended drone, hovers over a planter with a seedling. Text: Nguyen Manh Khang, AI safety, alignment guild.
